svg.title: AzadBird articulated source — unchanged resting silhouette
svg.desc: Derived from the project azadbird_bird.xml. Pigment #007FE5. Draw visible-wing first, body-head-tail second. Shoulder pivot in translated viewport is (113,115); original coordinates (418,210). Wing clockwise rotation 0 to 8 degrees only. Body has an internal overlap under the wing seam. No second wing invented.
